Gaurav Mehta, Founder of Jaipur Watch Company, a coin collector who taught himself watchmaking and built India's most distinctive watch brand.
He explains:
• Why a $200 Rolex once sold for $17.8 million and what made Paul Newman's Daytona the most expensive watch ever auctioned
• How to buy your first watch collection and which 3 watches Gaurav recommends starting with
• Why every shark on Shark Tank India rejected him and how that rejection became his best-performing ad campaign
• What Swiss watches actually invented versus what they simply got very good at marketing
